principles: Environment names are operational context; they do not override DOC-C/DOC-E authority.
Evidence is bound to exact commit/artifact/environment.
CI/infrastructure failure before test execution is BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT, not product FAIL/PASS.

environments.name: LOCAL
environments.canonical_config_rule: Must not silently diverge from canonical defaults; explicit local overrides are non-authoritative unless versioned/approved.
environments.secrets: Local runtime injection only; never commit.

environments.name: TEST
environments.canonical_config_rule: Use declared test configuration; semantic defaults remain tied to canonical config version.

environments.name: CI
environments.purpose: Hosted/reproducible automated verification and release-evidence generation.
environments.canonical_config_rule: Exact workflow/config must be pinned to target commit; environment failure must not be misclassified as code FAIL.
environments.secrets: CI secret store; no secret output.

environments.name: STAGING
environments.canonical_config_rule: Differences from production must be explicit/versioned; no silent semantic drift.

environments.name: CANARY
environments.purpose: Limited exact-artifact rollout for health/monitoring/rollback observation.
environments.canonical_config_rule: Must use exact release candidate artifact/config identity.
environments.secrets: Production-equivalent secret handling with least privilege.

environments.name: PRODUCTION
environments.canonical_config_rule: Only versioned/audited configuration; no environment-local silent drift.

unknowns: Exact canonical staging infrastructure/topology is not locked in the captured source.
Exact canonical canary topology/traffic percentage is not locked in the captured source.
Production cloud/provider/data-region topology is not established by current source/evidence.
